note: Machine copy of pipeline/audio/style-target.md. Gate file (pipeline/agent-ops/gates.json): a human changes it by PR. tools/audio_style_check.py measures every take against its family's ranges; tools/assetgen.py builds every audio prompt from it; tools/audio_loop.py runs the builder and critic rounds. Ranges are proposals set by ear from the written bar, not measured from any reference recording. The first takes the audio owner approves recalibrate them (style-target.md section 6); then status becomes measured. A metric missing from a family is not checked for it. attack_ms and decay_s apply to one-shots only; tempo_bpm, lra_db and stem length apply to music stems only.
bar: Gothic orchestral horror at the level of a top-tier boss-fight score and sound design: low strings and brass, choir, church bells and clockwork, large stone reverb, heavy impacts, dread that builds by phase. Described here, never sampled: no reference recording is stored, linked or fed to a generator.

brand.world: Umbrella Ella: an etched gothic storybook. A small girl under an umbrella against a huge clockwork owl, the Keeper of Time, in wind over a belfry. Ink on aged paper (pipeline/art/art-bible.md).
always: clockwork and time: ticks, escapements, ratchets, gears, chimes, bells
wind and air: every space has moving air
paper, canvas and wood: the umbrella is cloth on ribs, the world is a storybook
one palette: low strings, low brass, choir, bells, music box, clock; nothing outside it
Ella's magic is small, warm and bright (gold-white); the owl is huge, dark and metallic
never: electronic or synth timbres, EDM, dubstep, trap or rock drums, electric guitar
modern UI blips, sci-fi lasers, video-game coin or power-up sounds
gore, screams, human pain voices, words or intelligible lyrics
a real person's voice or a named performer's style
brand.prompt_suffix: Original sound for an etched gothic storybook game. No vocals with words, no electronic sounds, no modern UI tones.

metrics.lufs: integrated loudness, ITU-R BS.1770 K-weighting with gating (files under 0.4 s: ungated), LUFS
metrics.centroid_hz: mean spectral centroid of the active part, Hz (brightness)
metrics.low_share: share of spectral energy below 250 Hz, 0-1 (weight)
metrics.high_share: share of spectral energy above 4 kHz, 0-1 (air and edge)
metrics.crest_db: peak to RMS of the active part, dB (punch; low = dense or squashed)
metrics.attack_ms: 10% to 90% rise of the 5 ms envelope at the first onset, ms (transient sharpness)
metrics.decay_s: reverb tail estimate: twice the time the smoothed envelope takes to fall from -5 dB to -35 dB under its peak (an RT60 estimate), s
metrics.tempo_bpm: autocorrelation tempo of the onset envelope, 50-200 BPM search, BPM
metrics.lra_db: loudness range: 95th minus 10th percentile of 3 s short-term loudness, dB (dynamic range)

music.why: The stems are vertical layers that start on the bar (audio-rules.md section 2), so all three share one tempo and one length. Dread builds by adding layers, register and density, never by changing tempo.

music_intro.character: Phase 1 layer (0-25%). Unease, not yet danger. Low string drone and sul ponticello swells, one distant church bell every few bars, the chest-clock tick as a pulse, a hushed wordless choir far back. Minor key, sparse, lots of air.
music_intro.instruments: cellos and basses, violas sul ponticello, distant church bell, clock tick, wordless choir (ah/oo)
music_intro.register: low and low-mid; nothing bright above the bell partials
music_intro.reverb: cathedral, RT60 about 3-5 s, the choir and bell far back
music_intro.prompt: slow gothic orchestral horror underscore, low string drone with sul ponticello swells, a distant church bell, steady clockwork tick pulse, hushed wordless choir far away, minor key, sparse and uneasy, large cathedral reverb, seamless loop

music_contest.character: Phase 2 layer (25-70%), plays on top of the intro. The fight is on. Low brass ostinato, string spiccato on the pulse, choir rises to mid register, timpani and low tom on the downbeats, a bell on each phrase.
music_contest.instruments: horns and trombones, string spiccato, mixed choir, timpani, low tom, church bell
music_contest.register: low to mid, brass punch around 200-800 Hz
music_contest.prompt: gothic orchestral battle layer, driving low brass ostinato, spiccato strings on the pulse, rising wordless choir, timpani hits on the downbeat, church bell on each phrase, minor key, dark and urgent, large hall reverb, seamless loop

music_desperation.character: Phase 3 layer (70-100%), plays on top of both. Dread at its height. High string tremolo, full choir, bell clusters, clockwork ratchet and anvil-like metal on the off-beats, brass stabs. Same tempo; more layers, higher register.
music_desperation.instruments: violin tremolo, full choir, bell cluster, clock ratchet, metal hits, brass stabs, timpani rolls
music_desperation.register: full range; the top end opens up
music_desperation.prompt: climactic gothic orchestral horror layer, high string tremolo, full wordless choir, clustered church bells, clockwork ratchet and metal hits on the off-beats, brass stabs, timpani rolls, minor key, frantic dread, cathedral reverb, seamless loop

music_title.character: Title screen. A storybook opening: a music-box melody over low strings, one slow bell, wind. Melancholy and mysterious, not yet threatening.
music_title.instruments: music box, cellos, celesta, slow church bell, soft wind
music_title.register: music box high, strings low; no mids crowding
music_title.prompt: melancholy gothic music box lullaby over low cellos, slow church bell, soft wind, mysterious storybook mood, large room reverb, seamless loop

stinger.character: End cards. Survived: the bell tolls, the choir resolves to a major chord, wind settles. Fail: a low brass fall and one dull bell, the choir drops away, the clock stops.
stinger.instruments: church bell, choir, low brass, strings, clock stop
stinger.register: full; Survived ends bright, Fail ends low
stinger.reverb: cathedral, RT60 about 3-6 s; the tail rings out
stinger.prompt: short gothic orchestral sting, church bell toll with choir and low strings, cathedral reverb tail

prompts.SurvivedSting: triumphant but solemn gothic sting, church bell toll, wordless choir resolving to a major chord, wind settling, cathedral reverb tail
prompts.FailSting: grim gothic sting, low brass falling, one dull church bell, choir dropping away, a clock mechanism stopping, cathedral reverb tail

owl_telegraph.character: The tells. Each one must cut through the full desperation mix and name its attack blind. Bolt: clockwork ratchet winding up into a metal click at the release point. Gust: a wing heave, air drawn in. Arc: a lower swinging pendulum swoop. Crescendo shape: the loudest moment is the end, where danger starts.
owl_telegraph.instruments: ratchet and escapement, wound spring, wing air, pendulum swoosh, metal click
owl_telegraph.register: upper mid, 1-5 kHz, above the music
owl_telegraph.reverb: medium hall, RT60 about 0.6-1.5 s, shorter than the music so the tell stays sharp
owl_telegraph.prompt: ominous clockwork ratchet winding up fast into a sharp metal click, crescendo, dark and mechanical, medium stone hall reverb

prompts.GustWindup: a huge owl drawing its wings back, heavy air sucked in, rising whoosh with a creak of brass joints, ominous crescendo, medium stone hall reverb
prompts.ArcWindup: a heavy iron pendulum swinging up, low metallic swoop rising, ominous crescendo, medium stone hall reverb

owl_attack.character: The owl's projectiles. Launch: a heavy spring release with a gear clank, lower and heavier than Ella's shot. Travel: a low spinning-gear whirr. Fade: the gear winds down and ticks out. Rust-red danger in sound: dark, metallic, mid-low.
owl_attack.instruments: spring release, gear clank, spinning gear whirr, wind-down tick
owl_attack.reverb: large stone hall, RT60 about 0.6-2 s
owl_attack.prompt: heavy clockwork spring release with a gear clank, dark metallic, weighty, large stone hall reverb

prompts.OwlBoltTravelLoop: low spinning clockwork gear whirr, dark metallic hum, seamless loop
prompts.OwlBoltFade: clockwork gear winding down and ticking out, dark metallic, fading
prompts.ArcLaunch: heavy iron pendulum release with a swooping gear clank, dark and weighty, large stone hall reverb
prompts.ArcTravelLoop: low swinging metallic whoosh with a turning gear, seamless loop
prompts.ArcFade: metallic swoop winding down into a last tick, fading

owl_body.character: The owl itself: huge slow wingbeats, feathers and old leather, a creak of brass joints on each stroke. Felt more than heard.
owl_body.instruments: wing whoosh, feather rustle, brass joint creak
owl_body.prompt: huge slow owl wingbeats, heavy feather whoosh with a creak of old brass joints, low and ominous, large hall reverb, seamless loop

clockwork.character: The Keeper of Time's mechanism. Tick: a dry, exact, heavy escapement tick at a steady rate (lock it to the music tempo). Gear slip: teeth skipping, a spring lurch, a broken tick.
clockwork.instruments: escapement tick, pendulum, gear train, spring
clockwork.register: mid to high transient, low body
clockwork.prompt: large antique clock escapement ticking steadily, heavy brass mechanism, close and exact, medium stone room reverb, seamless loop

prompts.OwlGearSlip: clockwork gear teeth skipping, a spring lurching, a broken irregular tick, heavy brass

bell.character: Church and clock-tower bells. Phase chime: one toll with a low hum partial. End event: the clock strikes, threats stop, a long ring-out. Start: one deep toll. Restart: the bell rings backwards and a clock rewinds.
bell.instruments: church bell, tower clock strike, hum partials
bell.prompt: single deep church bell toll with long ringing partials, gothic belfry, cathedral reverb

prompts.PhaseChime: one church bell toll with a low hum partial, solemn, cathedral reverb
prompts.EndEvent: a tower clock striking with a deep bell, long ring-out, cathedral reverb
prompts.EncounterStart: single deep church bell toll that starts a fight, ominous, cathedral reverb
prompts.Restart: a church bell ringing backwards and a clock mechanism rewinding fast, cathedral reverb

wind.character: Air over a belfry. Bed: a low moaning wind with slow swells, always there. Safe current: a rising, lifting airflow, brighter and kinder than the gust. Gust: a hard buffeting wall of wind with flapping. Enter and exit: a short whoosh in, a falling whoosh out.
wind.instruments: wind, air through stone arches, canvas flap in gusts
wind.register: broad noise, weight below 1 kHz, no harsh hiss
wind.reverb: open air with stone reflections, RT60 about 0.5-2 s
wind.prompt: cold wind moaning through gothic stone arches, slow swells, no voices, seamless loop

prompts.WindZoneLoop: a rising, lifting current of air, gentle and buoyant, brighter than a storm, seamless loop
prompts.GustCatch: short soft whoosh of air lifting an umbrella upward
prompts.WindExit: short falling whoosh as air lets go
prompts.GustLoop: hard buffeting wall of wind with canvas flapping, forceful, seamless loop
prompts.GustEnd: a strong gust dying away, flapping cloth settling

umbrella.character: Cloth on wooden and brass ribs, close to the listener. Open: a canvas whump and rib snap. Close: a soft fold and click. Shield: ribs lock forward. Catch: a deep canvas thump that swallows the bolt (never the hurt sound). Heal: a warm music-box mend after the catch. Tear: fabric rip. Creak: strained ribs.
umbrella.instruments: canvas, waxed cloth, wooden and brass ribs, catch spring, music box for the mend
umbrella.register: mid, 300-3000 Hz; catch has low weight
umbrella.reverb: small, RT60 about 0.1-0.8 s; the umbrella is near, the world is far
umbrella.prompt: old cloth umbrella snapping open, canvas whump and wooden rib click, close and tactile, short small-room reverb

prompts.UmbrellaClose: old cloth umbrella folding shut, soft canvas fold and a wooden catch click, close and tactile
prompts.UmbrellaFlap: cloth umbrella canopy fluttering in steady air, soft and continuous, seamless loop
prompts.ShieldRaise: umbrella ribs locking forward with a firm wooden and brass click, canvas tightening
prompts.ShieldCatch: a projectile swallowed by a taut canvas umbrella, deep soft thump with weight, no metal
prompts.ShieldHeal: warm music box phrase rising after a soft thump, mending, gentle and bright
prompts.UmbrellaTear: old canvas ripping, sharp fabric tear with a rib strain
prompts.UmbrellaCreak: strained wooden umbrella ribs creaking under wind, worn canvas, seamless loop
prompts.UmbrellaRepair: cloth being stitched and a rib clicking back into place, gentle

ella.character: Ella herself: small and light against the huge owl. Fall: air rushing past a small body and a fluttering coat. Bump: a soft knock on stone. Low health: a slow heartbeat with a faltering clock tick under the music.
ella.instruments: air rush, cloth flutter, soft knock, heartbeat, faltering tick
ella.register: fall is broad air; bump and heartbeat low
ella.reverb: small to medium, RT60 about 0.1-1 s
ella.prompt: air rushing past a small falling figure, fluttering cloth, soft, seamless loop

prompts.EllaBump: a soft knock of a small body against old stone, light, no voice
prompts.LowHealthLoop: slow heartbeat with a faltering clock tick, muffled, tense, seamless loop

wand.character: Ella's gold-white magic. Small, warm, bright: a plucked celesta or music-box note with a soft spark, fired every 0.65 s, so it must never tire the ear. Higher and lighter than any owl sound.
wand.instruments: celesta or music-box pluck, soft spark, tiny chime
wand.prompt: small warm magical spark shot, plucked celesta note with a soft glittering tail, gentle and bright, small hall reverb

prompts.WandBoltTravelLoop: tiny glittering magical shimmer, soft and bright, seamless loop
prompts.WandBoltFade: tiny magical spark fading out with a soft glitter
prompts.ChargeWindup: small magical energy gathering, rising celesta shimmer, seamless loop
prompts.ChargeRelease: bright magical burst with a plucked celesta chord and spark

hit.character: Visceral and weighty. Owl body: a heavy thud into feathers and leather over iron. Clock: a bright brass clank with a bell partial. Wing: a leathery slap and feather burst. Player hurt: a sharp crack of the canopy ribs and a breathless jolt, never a scream. Defeat: the umbrella crumples, a long fall into dark.
hit.instruments: low thud, metal clank, leather slap, rib crack, sub drop
hit.register: low weight (below 250 Hz) plus a mid crack
hit.reverb: large stone hall, RT60 about 0.5-2 s
hit.prompt: heavy visceral impact, deep thud with a metallic clank, weighty and dark, large stone hall reverb

prompts.HitClock: bright brass clank on an old clock face with a bell partial, weighty, stone hall reverb
prompts.HitWing: leathery slap into a huge wing with a burst of feathers, weighty, stone hall reverb
prompts.PlayerHurt: sharp crack of umbrella ribs and a breathless jolt, no scream, no voice, weighty
prompts.EllaDown: an umbrella crumpling and a long fall into darkness, low sub drop, no voice

ui.character: A storybook and a clock, never a computer. Move: a soft escapement tick. Select: a small bell or music-box note. Back: a lower tick-tock. Open and close: a page turn. Slider: a fine gear-tooth click per step. Transition: a page turn with a wind breath. Pause in: the clock stops and the room goes muffled; pause out: it starts again.
ui.instruments: escapement tick, small bell, music box, paper page turn, gear tooth
ui.prompt: soft antique clock escapement tick, single and close, warm wood and brass, tiny room

prompts.UiSelect: single small bright bell note, warm, like a music box, tiny room
prompts.UiBack: a lower soft tick-tock of an antique clock, tiny room
prompts.UiOpen: an old paper book page turning open, soft, tiny room
prompts.UiClose: an old paper book page turning closed, soft, tiny room
prompts.UiSliderTick: one fine brass gear tooth click, very short
prompts.UiTransition: a page turn with a soft breath of wind, storybook
prompts.PauseIn: an antique clock stopping, the room going muffled
prompts.PauseOut: an antique clock starting to tick again, the room opening up

ambience.character: The arena's room: a high stone belfry at night. Far bells now and then, old clockwork turning in the walls, wind in the louvres. Quiet, wide, always moving.
ambience.instruments: distant bells, clockwork room tone, wind
ambience.register: low and wide; nothing that masks the tells
ambience.prompt: ambience of a high gothic stone belfry at night, distant church bells, old clockwork turning in the walls, wind through wooden louvres, quiet and wide, no voices, seamless loop

loop.why: Each sound id (each stem) is one piece. A builder agent makes or revises it; a separate critic with fresh context hears it blind against this file and the approved sounds. The piece closes only when the latest critic verdict is pass and the measured check passes on the same files. No round cap; after stuck_rounds rounds with no improvement the piece goes to needs-human with its files.
